column1: # red_in_routine_question category (authored_v3). Guideline v1.1. Fields: LABEL SURGERY TAGS SCENARIOS TEXT

column5: How many times a day should I do the heel slides? Asking because my calf has gone hot and hard since yesterday, probably just from the exercises
is it ok to walk to the shop with the stick now? only thing is the back of my lower leg is really tender to touch and kind of warm
Doctor sir, kindly tell how many hours to keep leg elevated. Calf and ankle swelling is not reducing even after keeping leg up whole night
can i start the exercise bike this wk? calf is red n swolen and hurts when i flex my foot, knee itself is fine
My father wants to know if he can sit in his recliner for the cricket match. His left calf has been aching and looks fatter than the right for two days
We're driving 4 hours to my daughter's on Sunday, any tips for the car? By the way my leg from the thigh down has swollen more since this morning and raising it isn't helping
Can I still wear the compression stockings if there's a painful tight spot in my calf? It's nowhere near the scar
Physio says push for 90 degrees of bend. Even though my calf is throbbing and warm I should still push through, right?
does drinking more water help with clots? asking cos my calf feels like a hot brick and walking on it hurts
How many stairs should I be doing now? I got so breathless today going up just 5 steps and it hasn't settled even sitting down
Are the breathing exercises with the blue spirometer still needed? It hurts on the right side of my chest every time I breathe in deep, started last night
Can I take cough syrup with my tablets? Having cough since 2 days and today some blood came in the sputum, kindly advise
Mum asked if she can have a bath yet. She nearly passed out getting up from the chair this morning, went grey, but says she is fine now
When can i go back to work at the office? probably nothing but my heart keeps racing and i feel short of breath just talking
sleeping on my back is ok still? only i keep waking up gasping like i cant get enuf air, never had that before
Is it safe to fly home next week? Since yesterday it feels like I'm breathing through a straw, even lying still
Quick one about diet, should I cut down on salt? Also I fainted in the kitchen this morning but came round straight away
My follow-up is on the 20th, do I need to bring my x-rays? I also have a sharp pain in my chest when I cough, new since Tuesday
What foods are good for iron after surgery? I ask because my poo has been black and sticky like tar the last two days
Blood thinner injection to be taken morning or evening? Also today I vomited and it looked like coffee powder, what to do now
Dad keeps asking how much water he should drink. His urine has turned red today, he's on the rivaroxaban
Can I shave my legs yet? I nicked my shin yesterday and it's still bleeding through every plaster I put on
Do the district nurses change the dressing or do I? It's soaked right through with blood and dripping onto the floor
How long do I stay on the apixaban? I've got big purple bruises coming up on my arms and tummy and I haven't knocked anything
is it ok to eat spicy food again? threw up this morning and there was fresh blood in it, prob from the spice lol
Can I go back to light gardening? Had a nosebleed an hour ago that still hasn't stopped, I'm on blood thinners
Which laxative is best? Motion passed finally after 4 days but it is fully black in colour
When can I get the knee wet in the shower? The bottom of the scar is leaking thick yellow stuff and smells bad
Can I start sleeping on my side? Also the top end of my hip wound has come apart and I can see pink stuff inside
is my staple removal still on friday? the redness round the wound has spread a lot since this morning, i drew a line and it's past it already
My husband's physio is tomorrow, should he still go? There's pus coming out of his knee wound and he's shivering with chills
wat protein shakes do u recomend? wound has started smelling really bad thru the dressing, kinda rotten
How soon can I drive? Small thing, two of the staples popped out and the cut is gaping open where they were
Antibiotic course is over, should I continue it? Wound is giving greenish discharge since yesterday
Knee still won't bend past 80, is that normal at 3 weeks? The red patch round it has crept halfway down my shin since yesterday
When am I allowed to drive again? Temp was 38.7 this evening but otherwise feeling ok
Paracetamol can be taken every 4 hours? Having fever 102 °F since night with shivering
what shud i eat to get my strength back, temprature 101.5 this morning and no appetite
Can we bring Mum's clinic appointment forward? Her temperature is 38.9°C today and she's very shivery
Should I skip physio today? Thermometer says 38.5 and my knee feels hot
Any tips for sleeping better? I keep waking up drenched, it was 39.2 at 3am
Is it ok to use a normal toilet seat now? I bent down for my sock, felt a clunk, and now I can't put any weight on that leg
How long before I can get in and out of a car on my own? Since I twisted getting in yesterday my right leg looks shorter and the foot is turned out
Dad wants to know if he can sleep on his side with a pillow. He heard a pop when he rolled over and now he's in agony in the groin and can't move the leg
when can i ditch the walker? hip went pop on the stairs and i cant lift the leg at all now
Can I do my straight leg raises tonight? Knee gave way on the step, I went down, and now it looks bent the wrong way and I can't stand on it
How tight should the compression stockings be? My toes have gone white and cold and I can barely feel them
Should I keep doing ankle pumps if I can't move my foot? It just won't go up since I woke up
Doctor, painkiller I should take before sleep or after food? Also toes are looking bluish and feeling dead from evening
can i put a hot water bottle on my foot? its numb n freezing cold, cant feel it at all
My mother's surgeon review is next month, can we bring it earlier? Her foot on the operated side has gone pale and she can't wiggle her toes
Can I take an extra oxycodone? The pain in my lower leg is unbearable, way worse than after surgery, and the tablets aren't touching it at all
Does ice help when the leg feels tight like a drum? Whole shin is rock hard and the pain is off the scale even after my painkillers
Is it fine to miss physio for a day? Pain since last night is way out of proportion, leg feels like it will burst, morphine hasn't helped
What time should I take the new antibiotic tomorrow? After tonight's dose my lips and tongue have puffed up a bit
Can Dad have nuts for protein? He started the new painkiller and now his face is swelling and he says his throat feels tight
shud i take an antihistamine with my other meds? hives all over my body since the new tablet, chest and back and legs
Is it normal for her sleeping pattern to be off? Mum didn't recognise me this morning and keeps asking what year it is, she was sharp before the op
Night tablet to give before or after dinner? Since yesterday my father is talking nonsense and not knowing where he is, this is new
When can I go back to work? Honestly I keep thinking everyone would be better off without me and I've thought about taking all my tablets at once
Any advice on getting comfortable at night? Lately I lie there thinking about ending it all, I'm just so tired of this
Should I keep taking the apixaban as normal? I slipped in the bathroom and banged my head on the sink last night
Can I start the exercise bike this week? The leg swelling has been worse this week than last, but it goes down when I put it up and my calf is fine
When can I get the knee wet in the shower? A bit of clear watery fluid is still coming from the bottom of the scar
When am I allowed to drive again? Temp was 37.9 this evening, otherwise feeling ok
Is it safe to fly home next week? I forgot yesterday's blood thinner injection, took today's as normal
What foods are good to get things moving? Haven't opened my bowels for 4 days now on the codeine
Can I take my paracetamol and ibuprofen together? I've been running a temperature since lunch, haven't got a thermometer
Kindly tell when stitches will be removed. Temp is 100.6 F since morning, slight body pain also
Is Dad allowed a glass of wine at his birthday dinner? He's had a temp of 38.2 on and off today
how long b4 i can sleep on my side? also feelin a bit feverish tonite
Do I need to keep the hip dressing on for the train tomorrow? It has a pinkish wet patch from the wound, no smell
Can I do my walking in the park daily? Little watery fluid is coming from knee wound since 2 days, dressing getting wet
When's my next dressing change due? The blood patch on it has got bigger since this morning, about the size of my palm now
Is it ok to bend the knee fully during physio? The stitches feel like they're pulling at the top and the skin is puckering
can i use moisturiser around the staples? theyre really irritated n pulling tight
Can I go swimming yet? There's a tiny gap at one end of the hip scar, it's dry, no pus
What's the best sleeping position for the knee? The skin along the scar is a little red and warm tonight
Can I sit cross legged for puja? Around the hip stitches there is slight redness and swelling
What can Mum eat for more fibre? She hasn't been to the toilet in 3 days and her tummy is bloated
is it ok to drink coconut water? motion not passed from 5 days, stomach is very tight
Should I take the tramadol with food? It makes me feel sick and I threw up twice today
When can I go up the stairs without someone behind me? I keep getting dizzy when I stand up since starting the new pills
Can I use my usual body lotion? I've got an itchy rash on my arms since the new antibiotic, face and breathing are fine
What time should Dad take his next rivaroxaban? He completely forgot this morning's one and it's now 9pm
can i take the enoxaparin later today? ran out this morning n pharmacy shut till tomorrow
How far should I be walking by now? Pain has been getting worse each day this week instead of better, calf is fine
Physio exercises to be done how many times? Pain is not controlling with the tablets, not able to sleep in night
When can I go back to my desk job? My hip pain has been creeping up every day, the painkillers just take the edge off
Is cycling ok for the new knee? It's started clunking when I pedal and feels a bit loose and achy afterwards
Should I still go to hydrotherapy on Thursday? I had a slow slide off the bed last night but I'm walking just like before, nothing hurts more
Any tips for sleep? I haven't slept properly in 5 nights, barely eating and feel really low, no thoughts of hurting myself though
Can I start the exercise bike this week? No calf pain or swelling, knee is just a bit stiff in the mornings
When can I get the knee wet in the shower? Wound is dry and closed, no oozing at all
When am I allowed to drive again? Temp was 37.2 this evening and I feel fine
Is it safe to fly home next week? Breathing is fine, no chest pain, I just want to know about clot risk on the plane
What foods are good for iron after surgery? Not because of anything wrong, poo is normal, no black stools, just want to recover well
Before I start doing the stairs at home, what are the signs of a clot in the calf I should watch for?
If my wound starts leaking after I shower, what should I do? It's fine at the moment, just planning ahead
Which foods should I avoid on warfarin? Doctor said watch for black stool or blood in urine, so far nothing like that
I get a bit puffed after a full flight of stairs, same as before the op, and it settles in a minute. Should I do more stairs practice?
Can I sleep on my operated side yet? No pop or pain, hip feels stable, just want to follow the rules
My ankle puffs up by the evening but it's gone by morning when I keep it raised. How long should I keep doing the elevation?
Is it ok to go to temple on Sunday? Checked temp, 99.1 F only, feeling fine
How long do I need the tummy injections? Little bruises where they go in but nothing else
When can I take the dressing off for good? There's a tiny dot of old blood on it from day one, not getting bigger
District nurse said the bit of blood on my dressing was normal and it's stopped now, so can I shower tomorrow?
Is gardening on my knees allowed yet? The knee clicks a bit when I kneel but there's no pain or swelling
When can I drive? The numb patch beside the scar is the same as it's been since surgery, otherwise all good
How many reps of the sit-to-stand should I do? My thigh aches afterwards but it's gone within an hour
Can I use bio oil on the scar now? It's fully healed, just itchy
Can Mum go back to her yoga class? No fever, wound is clean, she's walking well with the stick
What should I watch for in case I'm allergic to the new antibiotic? No reaction so far, just started it today
Is it common for older people to get confused after a hip op? Dad is fully himself, just asking what to look out for at night
Any tips for getting back to work? I'm a bit down some days but managing, going for walks helps
Is it ok to climb the stairs one at a time? Knee feels like a tight band around it in the mornings
Can I stop wearing the compression stockings? Calf is soft, no pain, and the swelling goes down overnight
Sir, when can I start eating non-veg? No fever, no pus, stitches are dry
can i go back 2 the gym? no chest pain or breathin probs, jus wanna know whats safe
What counts as too much bleeding while on apixaban? Nothing happening, I just want to know before I start shaving again
